_help: Notification rules for the specialkapa.notifications plugin. Saved changes apply at once.
sources: named senders shown in the bar panel, each with a mute switch. A muted source's
notifications skip the popup (mutedAction) but still land in history and the unread count.
match keys: app (app names), host (web sites; 'office.com' also matches sub-domains),
summary / body / text (case-insensitive regex). All given keys must match; any list item may.
"muted": true starts a source muted until you flip it in the panel.
rules: checked first, in order; the first match wins. action: show, silent or drop.
"source": "<id>" limits a rule to one source.
Senders not listed here still appear in the panel once they notify, and can be muted there.
